value.title: Destroy
value.description: Keeps nothing, and lets the item go.

value.title: Equip
value.description: Keeps the item to wear on a character or a companion.

value.title: Hoard
value.description: Keeps the item in storage against a later need.

value.title: Progress
value.description: Keeps the item for the progress the item carries a player toward.

value.title: Sell
value.description: Keeps the item to turn into gold.

value.title: Task
value.description: Keeps the item for a task that calls for the item.

value.title: Unlock
value.description: Keeps the item until the collection the item belongs to is unlocked.

value.title: Use
value.description: Keeps the item to be used up.
